UPDATE sync.tb_s_synchronization
SET last_sync_status = 1, 
remarks = @remarks
WHERE sync_name = @sync_name

UPDATE sync.tb_s_synchronization
SET last_sync_status = 0, 
last_sync_period_from = @last_sync_period_from, 
last_sync_period_to = @last_sync_period_to
WHERE sync_name = @sync_name

BEGIN TRAN
BEGIN TRY
	INSERT INTO sync.tb_s_synchronization_history (sync_id, pipeline_run_id, trigger_time, status)
	VALUES (@sync_id, @run_id, @sync_period_to, 'Success')

	UPDATE sync.tb_s_synchronization
	SET status = 'Success', 
	last_success_sync_on = @sync_period_to,
	remarks = NULL
	WHERE sync_id = @sync_id

	COMMIT TRAN;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
	ROLLBACK TRAN;
	THROW;
END CATCH

BEGIN TRAN
BEGIN TRY
	INSERT INTO sync.tb_s_synchronization_history (sync_id, pipeline_run_id, trigger_time, status, remarks)
	VALUES (@sync_id, @run_id, @sync_period_to, 'Fail', @remarks)

	UPDATE sync.tb_s_synchronization
	SET status = 'Fail',
	remarks = @remarks
	WHERE sync_id = @sync_id

	COMMIT TRAN;
END TRY

	ROLLBACK TRAN;
	THROW;
